dct_description_sm: There is currently very little scientific data available about the engineering properties of deformed (hummocked) multi-year sea ice. As such, this research is part of an integrated sea ice project to provide regionally-relevant information on dangerous ice features to enhance the decision-making capacity of regulators and industry. This project will provide information required to better engineer structures for impact with hummocked multi-year ice, which is considered by the engineering community to be the most hazardous but least understood type of sea ice. Increased understanding of sea ice will contribute to better planning in the Beaufort Sea and improve the safety of operations in the region.
dct_title_s: Characterizing Deformed Multi-Year Ice in the Beaufort Sea
